'''Andras Gospari''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[war against Zakuul]] he became a member of the [[Eternal Alliance]] and traveled to the [[Alliance base]] on [[Odessen]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Andras Gospari appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' expansion as the [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]] flashpoint rewards vendor.

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
